naming.discouragedAlias: “Hook Trigger” is not an official name. Prefer Easy Play (tap-next-chord) plus Shout/Worship levels.

playerNotes.exclusive: Setting shoutLevel > 0 clears worshipLevel, and vice versa.
playerNotes.renderScale: Math.max(shoutLevel, worshipLevel) / 4 feeds drumBar; chord samples use Math.max(shoutLevel, worshipLevel, 1) / 4.
playerNotes.olderFiveLevelMap: chord-maps/shout-iv-v-bvii.json intensityMap used a design overlay of 1–5. Follow Me should ship Shout 1–4 and Worship 1–4 to match the player. Do not add a fifth detent unless Lawrence asks.

intensityWiring.howMapsFeedEngine: Easy Play advances progression.steps; setKey() re-resolves tokens via chordIn; shoutLevel/worshipLevel scale renderChord/drumBar intensity (level/4); Follow Voice may nudge shout/worship. Chord-map JSON supplies tokens + resolved MIDI for all 12 keys so Follow Me (module src/pulpit/PulpitPlayer) / the sequencer can skip live theory if desired. Look up progressions[id].charts[keyName] (minor progressions use parallel-minor names: Fm, Cm, …). Hook chords are hookChords.byKey[keyName].

organRunCues.description: Descending Mixolydian run from the tonic (8 eighths). Use at Shout 3–4.
Blues-scale fill (generic vocabulary, not a quoted lick). Peak shout only.
Short chromatic gliss into the next downbeat. Shout 3–4.
Organ-talk call-and-response stabs (I answers IV). Available from Shout 2 up.

hookChords.description: Single-tap vocabulary from the reference transcription (most-heard chords).

progressions.name: Shout cadence (6–5–1, blue 3rd)
progressions.desc: Most repeated move in the Gb section: 6m7 → 5sus → 1 with the minor 3rd bending up to major (i → I). Heard 3×.

analysis.uncertain: i vs I: both 3rds are present (blues shout colour); the order minor→major is the best fit, not certain. 5 may be 5(7sus4)/5(9sus4) — 7th not resolved by the detector.
VI7 lasts only ~2 beats; could be a passing 6(7#9).

progressions.name: Augmented lick (7 → 1+ → b3 sus2)
progressions.desc: Pickup from the 7 into 1 augmented (Gb bass), then b3 sus2 (A sus2 over A in Gb). Same 3-chord shape heard twice, identically.

analysis.uncertain: The pickup (VIImaj7) is ~1 beat. 1+ might be a 1(7#5) or a 1(7#9) voicing split across two bars; b3 sus2 could be the upper part of 1(7#9).

progressions.name: Long turnaround into the half-step lift
progressions.desc: The full phrase before the key change: 1+ → b3sus2 → 2m → b2maj7 → 6m7 → 5sus → 1maj7 → 1sus → #4dim7 → new 1 (up a half step).

analysis.uncertain: Between 78.6–81.3 s the detector heard a weak 5m9 with a chromatic bass walk-down (b7 6 b6 5) — left out of the tokens. #4dim7 is 1 beat; it works as a rootless V7b9 of the new key.

modulation.note: Last chord (bII) is the new 1 — the key goes up a half step (Gb → G at 90.6 s).

progressions.name: Half-step lift (key up one)
progressions.desc: 1sus → #4dim7 (= rootless 5(7b9) of the new key) → new 1. Tonal centre move Gb → G is clear in both engines.

analysis.uncertain: The key change itself is high confidence; the exact pivot chord (dim7) is 1 beat, medium.

progressions.name: 4m9 walk-up back to 1 — check by ear

analysis.uncertain: Chord labels here disagree with the bass line; only the bass walk-up and the #4 sus2 (C sus2 in Gb, 4 beats) are fairly clear. Needs ear check before shipping.
analysis.bassWalk: b-line ~59–62 s: 5 6 b7 7 → 1 (Db Eb E F → Gb in Gb), chromatic walk-up

analysis.uncertain: #IV9 (C9 in Gb) and bIII are weak matches; the walk-down in the bass is clearer than the chords.
analysis.bassWalk: b-line ~42–48 s: 7 6 b6 5 (F Eb D Db in Gb), chromatic walk-down into 5

progressions.name: Lifted shout (1 → 4sus2 → #4ø7 → 5sus)
progressions.desc: Main loop after the key change: 1 → 4 sus2 → #4 half-dim → 5 sus. Heard 3× (G section).

analysis.uncertain: 4 sus2 (C sus2 in G) = Gsus4/C pitch set; the 3rd of 4 is weak/absent. Once it was heard as #4m triad instead of ø7.

progressions.name: Lifted shout, extended (4(9) → 2 → 1(7sus) → #4ø7 → 5sus)
progressions.desc: Variation of the lifted loop. Heard 1×.

analysis.uncertain: #4 was detected as a minor triad (C#m in G); charted as ø7 to match the other bars — a judgement call. II may be II7.

progressions.name: Lifted tag (1(7#9) → 4 → 2(7) → 4sus2 → 1maj7)
progressions.desc: Blues-shout tag before the last loop. Heard 1×.

analysis.uncertain: A one-beat bIIImaj7 at 123.1 s was dropped as a passing hit.
